title: Very basic, for a small bathroom, or personal desk heater.
text:
Very basic, for a small bathroom, or personal desk heater.. This is a very basic small heater. 6 in. tall, 6 in wide, 3 in. deep. Has a switch to turn it on in the back bottom.
You do not get to adjust the heat, its just comes on when you push the bottom, and was I disappointed when I took
it out of the box!

But if you need this for a small bathroom, it will heat it up, but does takes awhile.
This heater is only 500 W. saves on electricity, as sometimes we forget to turn it off.
My dressing room is not in my bathroom, so the area this heated up is just my shower & toilet area, with a heated towel rack.
There is a sliding door I keep closed when I’m in the shower, and this little heater did better then I expected.

I think its also for a personal heater on your desk to keep to you warm, but not hot.
For the price its good.
